motions.item_title: Adopt a Proclamation of the Mayor of Eagle Mountain City Regarding Short-Term Water Prohibition…
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt a Proclamation of the Mayor of Eagle Mountain City Regarding Short-Term Water Prohibitions on the Outdoor Use of Water in a Portion of Eagle Mountain City, selecting option 2 as the area in which the outdoor use of water is prohibited, and allowing individuals to provide water to animals, hand watered gardens, and drip irrigation. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Outdoor watering banned in part of the city
motions.summary: The city temporarily banned outdoor water use in one area of Eagle Mountain, with exceptions for watering animals, hand-watered gardens, and drip irrigation.
motions.impact: If you live in the affected area, you cannot run sprinklers or hoses on your lawn while the ban is in place, though you may still water animals by hand, hand-water a garden, and use drip irrigation. Other parts of the city are not covered.
